## 1. Ruling — none on wording; the merged runtime change is the specification

No maintainer ruling on this text. The truth the skills must state landed as PR #23971 (`Fixes #23910`, merged `b25d98a46f`, 2026-10-16). Its changeset, verbatim (`git show b25d98a46:.changeset/23910-validation-previous-insert.md`; consumed into `packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md` L35–42 by today's version PR):

> On insert, `previous` is now bound to `null` in validation rules and in declarative hook conditions, so a rule or condition that reads it decides the insert — the binding a flow's start condition already gets on its create leg. … `previous == null || …` judges an insert, `previous != null && …` skips one. A column read off `previous` on insert (`previous.stage`) still has no value and still refuses the write; the refusal now names that read and the guard to add. … The binding is the same for every predicate a write evaluates — a `script` / `cross_field` condition, a `conditional`'s `when`, a field's `requiredWhen` and an option's `visibleWhen` — and for a hook's `condition` on `beforeInsert` / `afterInsert`; the validate-only preview judges an insert the same way. Only the CEL binding is `null`: a hook's `ctx.previous` is unchanged. … A write to an existing row whose prior state is not in hand keeps `previous` unbound and still fails closed, so `previous == null` never reads an update as an insert.

`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` L211 on `main` already states it: 「`null` on insert, so `previous == null` judges an insert; a column read off it there (`previous.status`) has no value and faults | validation, hook conditions and flows — `null` on insert」.

**Deliverable:** ONE draft PR to `main`. Body line 1 `Fixes #23983`, line 2 `Clause-②: no`. Files: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (the bullet at L247–248 「**`previous` is UNBOUND where there is no prior state** … One case: insert events … write those over `record` alone」 and the L280 clause 「the unbound-`previous` and `has(...)` bullets above are load-bearing」), `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` (the scope-table row L306 「Insert events … **unbound** — there is no prior state」 and the note L312–314 「Referencing `previous` where it is unbound … So write insert-event conditions over `record` alone」), and ONE changeset `.changeset/23983-previous-null-on-insert.md` with `'@objectstack/skills': patch` and `Clause-②: no` (precedent: PR #23795's `.changeset/23753-navigation-record-surface.md`). ⛔ No other `skills/**` file: other occurrences of 「unbound」 go in the report as out-of-scope findings with the grep evidence. `skills/**` is Tier H governed: carry `## 维护者速读(草稿)` (five parts, Chinese, 席位意见 blank), stay draft; the seat requests the authorized reviewers — you do not.

## 2. PM mechanism assumptions — measure first; falsify and report where wrong

- **(a) Token budget (the ratchet `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`):** `data-hooks.md` 10066/10066 (headroom 0) — every token the new sentences cost is paid by lossless deletion inside the same file; `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 5399/5997 (headroom 598). ⛔ Ceilings do not move; ⛔ re-wrapping is not payment; the PR body shows the before/after of each file and of the catalog.
- **(b) The three facts to state** (card section 「What the corrected text says」): on insert `previous` is `null` in validation, hook conditions and flows (`previous == null || …` judges an insert, `previous != null && …` skips one); a column read off it on insert (`previous.status`) has no value and faults; an existing row whose prior state is not in hand keeps `previous` unbound. The current advice 「write insert-event conditions over `record` alone」 is still safe but no longer the rule — rewrite it as the `null` guard, do not delete the safety.
- **(c) What else reads these files:** `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into `packages/skills/dist` (a published package, hence the changeset); `packages/spec` has `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` gates with generators `gen:skill-docs` / `gen:skill-refs` for `SKILL.md` changes — run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` and regenerate ONLY what it proves stale (`--fix`), commit any regenerated artifact; `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` and `check:skill-top-level-keys` read skill bodies. Derive the full list with dispatch-gates.
- **(d) The Version Packages PR** re-stamps `skills/*/SKILL.md` version lines every six hours (#23825 merged today); your hunk at L306 is disjoint. If the base moves under you, merge `origin/main` only on a reported conflict.

- `data-hooks.md` L247: 「**`previous` is `null` on insert and UNBOUND only where a prior row exists but is not in hand.** `previous == null` judges an insert and `previous != null && …` skips one; a column read off it on insert (`previous.done`) has no value and faults, so guard the read, not the event.」 Pay by trimming the L280 clause to its still-true half (the `has(...)` bullet is load-bearing; the `previous` half now names the `null` guard).

## Four-axis framework (verbatim from `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` L241–261 at `origin/main` `697301491`, file touch `f7e836da1`, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`)

**每个方案必须沿四条固定评估轴分析,这是决策分析的核心原则,不是可选项:**

- **实际业务需求** — 它服务的是**真实存在的业务场景**,
  还是投机性能力面?判据要求**实测**(谁在写这个键、谁在读、
  示例应用与真实部署的用法),「读起来像有用」不作数。这条轴会改变结论,不是陪衬。
- **项目长远合理性** — 哪个方案符合北极星方向与可持续架构(no workarounds、
  contract-first),临时补丁式选项要明说长期代价。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错,尤其是防 AI 写元数据 app 犯错** — 哪个方案让 AI 在结构上*更难写错*:
  契约收紧(严格 schema、publish 时响亮拒绝)优于消费端宽容(`??` 回退、静默容错)——
  宽容恰是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床;声明即强制,绝不让 AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — **创业阶段聚焦原则**:创业项目先专注核心能力,能力扩张默认
  从紧,无拉动的声明面按 implementation-first 处置,已发布零消费能力不因沉没成本豁免。
  **过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进**:废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认**立即退休**,无分阶段
  窗口、无双拼写宽限;staged 仅凭具名外部用户证据方可荐。**新增门禁默认否**:门禁是只减
  不增的零件,例外只有维护者点名;荐新增门禁须引其点名原话,否则荐「不加」。

**基本裁决原则**:spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面;声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役,
⛔ 不在消费端收窄;未声明键随实现,文档随之。「声明即强制」只及 spec 与元数据契约、
运行时能力,⛔ 不及 AGENTS.md 这类给 agent 读的约定 —— 那些的读者是 agent,不是门禁。
推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由;四轴冲突时如实呈现权衡,
交维护者拍板。
